published_prior_art.cite: HaughSingal2023DynamicLatent gives dynamic hidden-state CQI polynomial optimization; ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCounterfactual gives canonical-SCM polynomial bounds.

Closest checked results are LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP one-transition bounds, HaughSingal2023DynamicLatent finite-record optimization, and SayedanaCainesMahajan2025 fixed-kernel concentration; none gives a compatible-fiber uniform rate.
No checked source gives a full-support stationary-feedback lower witness for conditional compatible-SCM interval width.
HaughSingal2026Casino supplies time-homogeneous EWAC LP bounds; the claimed finite-horizon rate specialization requires a defined embedding and source verification.
KaidoMolinariStoye2019CalibratedProjection gives asymptotic calibrated projection inference, not this deterministic finite-sample fiber inclusion.
deLaPenaLaiShao2009 and RakhlinSridharanTewari2015 provide general martingale tools but no posterior-normalized compatible-response-polytope result.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 (casino-rate)
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted finite-state embedding, its state/action map, and the derivation of h=r and span(h)≤1 are undefined, so the claimed specialization cannot yet be checked as an instance of the model class.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 and related_work casino comparison
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed Section 4.3 qualitative T→∞ identification is not located in the inspected arXiv v3, while the cited Journal of Causal Inference primary version was inaccessible; provide the exact journal locator or downgrade the comparison.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2 and Proposition 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The whole-polytope root-T maximal inequality and its explicit constant remain an open solve target; current presolve support is only O(sqrt(log T/T)) over the full polytope.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The root-T headline and casino-rate corollary are conditional on an affirmative resolution of Open-ended Question 1; a negative resolution instead defines the unchanged-class rate frontier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes finite canonical SCM representation and tight counterfactual bounds through polynomial programs.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 11–12, Theorems 17–18; p. 48, Lemma 67 proof use
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives fixed-policy average-reward martingale decompositions and finite-time concentration bounds involving the policy bias/value function.

The paper optimizes dynamic latent-state counterfactual bounds over causal mechanisms using polynomial optimization, with a terminal probability-of-necessity application and no record-length contraction theorem.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2502.13731v5; corroborating version for the in-press AAMAS 2026 paper
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source gives one-observed-transition counterfactual transition bounds and states transition probabilities are assumed known, with uncertain learned MDPs left for future work.
The paper develops bootstrap calibrated projection confidence intervals with uniform asymptotic coverage for moment-(in)equality models.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v3 corroborating source; cited Journal of Causal Inference version was publisher-inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible version derives time-homogeneous and time-inhomogeneous EWAC LP bounds under a direct fair-die intervention; the asserted journal Section 4.3 long-run identification requires primary-source verification.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the dishonest-casino embedding completely, including state space, action semantics, reward normalization, transition rows, epsilon, and a direct verification of the Poisson equation; then verify the exact journal section supporting the comparator claim.

Make the synchronizer-square kill test the immediate Stage-0 obligation and either prove the full-polytope root-T maximal inequality or replace the root-T theorem with the sharp rate actually supported by the test.
State a strict comparison theorem against the homogeneous casino LP class or a generic class of stationary dynamic-SCM programs, rather than relying on an unverified qualitative-asymptotic claim.

recommended_next_step: Revise the casino specialization and its source anchor, retain the disclosed conditional scope for the root-T target, then advance the synchronizer-square kill test as the first Stage-0 task.
